# R6.7 — price-lane (manifest 260, block INFRA, alias PRICE + LANE)

Base: `origin/main` @`bdc7979` (R6.6, PR #300). Two ordered stages, checkpoint committed green before stage 2 — `00b09570` stage 1, `a7941c38` stage 2. `mergePolicy: OPERATOR` — never merged by the agent.

## What landed

**Stage 1 — PRICE (AR-09 / ADR-0425; REQ-XC-116, alias REQ-XC-008)**

- `crates/hh-budget/src/pricing.rs` — `RateUnit { micro_per_token, micro_per_1k_tokens }`; `PricingUnit` trait + `RatedPricingTable { table, rate_unit }`: `PricingTable` carries the spec default `micro_per_token` **by construction**, so the five frozen struct-literal construction sites (hh-budget unit tests, `r5_13`, `golden_usage`, `account`, `r4_5d`) stay byte-unchanged — a mandatory field cannot be added under stable Rust. `price`/`attribute_spend`/`Account::attribute_spend` are generic over the carrier: exact per-call nano-µ$ sum (`i128`), **one** ceil to the µ$, roles itemize `floor` plus a `rounding` role present iff the residual is non-zero (per-token sums are always integral → pre-existing itemizations byte-identical).
- `RateUnit::rate_from_micro_per_1m` / `PricingRow::from_micro_per_1m` — `NoPrice{unrepresentable_rate}` on a non-integral rate, never rounded into place.
- `ollama_glm_5_3_flash()` — 150/30/500 µ$ per 1k (input/cached/output), `valid_from 2026-10-22`, source citing experiments-spec §4.1.
- `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r4_5d.rs` — the F11 comment correction (`1000 micro/token ⇒ $1/1k`); comment only.
- `crates/hh-budget/tests/r6_7.rs` — AC-1 golden trial prices to **3 151 µ$** hand-computed, `rounding` = 2, itemization sums exactly; AC-2 refusals.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0425-*.md` — records the carrier decision, the one-rounding rule, and the **`DeclaredPricing` disposition: declared out of scope for paid studies** (it stays the router's dated reservation estimate; paid consumers read `PricingTable` via `PricingUnit` — no second representation, CC1).

**Stage 2 — LANE (AR-11 / ADR-0426; REQ-XC-104, alias REQ-XC-001)**

- `crates/hh-gateway/src/dialects.rs` — `ollama-chat@1` and `ollama-messages@1` lane documents (clone-and-override on the family docs — one grammar spelling): `auth_kinds: [bearer]` on both (every Ollama surface Bearer-only); `tool_choice`/`metadata`/cache-control keys not admitted (unsupported upstream); `reasoning_effort`/`output_config`/`budget_tokens` admitted; `cache uncached`, `count_tokens: none`. Responses not built (C-32).
- `crates/hh-gateway/src/http_transport.rs` — `family_of` maps `ollama-messages` → Messages; `lane_auth_header`/`auth_form_header` derive the auth header from declared `auth_kinds` (the ADR-0366 amendment): **byte-identical** for `anthropic-messages@1` (`x-api-key`), `openai@1`/`openai-compatible@1` (Bearer), credential-less local lane (no header). `forward_raw(...) → RawExchange{status, headers, body, chunk_stamps}` — same dial/TLS/`hh-wire` codec, request bytes verbatim, raw capture JSON+SSE, non-2xx captured not classified, caller-supplied auth headers refused `invalid_request`, undeclared auth forms refuse `unsupported_feature`. `raw_frames` replays captures through `SseDecoder`+family `Translator`/`completion_frames` = the `send` frames path. Credential resolves in-call, drops on return — no returned surface carries it.
- `crates/hh-wire/src/http.rs` — `write_response_head_chunked`/`write_chunk`/`finish_chunked` + `reason()` 402/429/502/503/504 (design 33 §4 hint 2, the proxy's buffered-release pieces).
- `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r6_7.rs` — AC-4 Bearer on both lanes / no `x-api-key`; AC-5 byte-identical captures + decode equality vs `send`; AC-6 auth regression + typed refusals; AC-7 `leak_scan` clean.
